title: Validate Hermes runtime integration

context.summary: Validate the Hermes adapter against the actual Hermes runtime surface instead of only the local lifecycle abstraction.
context.background: The adapter passed local acceptance, but a full MVP needs confirmation that real Hermes hooks, identity mapping, attachments and session recall behave correctly.

in: Document the exact Hermes lifecycle hooks Mindory integrates with.
Wire or verify ensure identity, prepare context, save user/assistant turns and upload attachments against real Hermes runtime behavior.
Confirm external session mapping and later-session recall.
Add a smoke or contract test using the available Hermes integration surface.
Update Hermes adapter docs with setup and limitations.
out: Persist Hermes data outside the Mindory API contract.

acceptance_criteria: The adapter is verified against the actual Hermes lifecycle surface or a documented local contract fixture that mirrors it.
Identity mapping is deterministic for project, user peer, agent peer and session.
User and assistant turns are saved through the API.
Attachments are uploaded when Hermes exposes them.
A later session can recall relevant context through Mindory.

manual_checks: Confirm real Hermes assumptions are documented with dates and source.
Confirm no direct DB access is introduced in the adapter.

risks: Hermes runtime APIs may be unavailable locally or may differ from current assumptions.
Attachment metadata can diverge from document upload metadata if not normalized.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
